subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported skill-source opt-out for `~/.agents/skills`, and should that API be source-id based or path/ignore-list based?
rationale: The source reproduction is clear, but the fix adds public config and changes a deliberate cross-agent discovery behavior with precedence and watcher tests, so the permanent API shape needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Add source-id opt-out
options.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load` setting keyed by stable source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, preserving current defaults and documenting upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add path ignore list
options.body: Expose a broader ignore-list API that can suppress personal and project skill directories, with explicit path normalization and watcher semantics.

options.title: Keep current scanning
options.body: Leave `.agents/skills` discovery unconditional and direct users to per-skill disables, agent allowlists, prompt limits, or moving Claude-only skills outside the shared directory.

recommendation.title: Add source-id opt-out
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load` setting keyed by stable source ids such as `agents-skills-personal`, preserving current defaults and documenting upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He has adjacent watcher/source-history ownership for the current skills-source surface that the decision would change.
